mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.5% (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) indicates active monetary easing that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.5% (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth (GDPC1) > 0.5% YoY and housing starts (HOUST) > 0.3% MoM indicate robust consumer demand, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 0.5% YoY and HOUST growth > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both GDPC1 growth > 0.5% YoY and HOUST growth > 0.3% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Low CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL growth < 2.5% YoY) signals stable price environment where the Fed maintains accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL growth < 2.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO > 0.2% MoM) indicates manufacturing momentum that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 0.2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth exceeding 0.5% MoM (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) reflects labor market strength that increases consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent retail sales (RSAFS) growth > 0.3% MoM and housing starts (HOUST) growth > 0.2% MoM signal strong consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > 0.3% MoM and HOUST growth > 0.2% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when RSAFS growth > 0.3% MoM and HOUST growth > 0.2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate at or below 0.5% (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) following FOMC easing decisions creates immediate market optimism, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% (Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window).
